title: Reproducible dataset for Three-Dimensional Wide-Angle Split-Step Parabolic-Equation Modelling of Urban Microcells (MAP-2026-10-0176)
description: Reproducible dataset accompanying the manuscript 'Three-Dimensional Wide-Angle Split-Step Parabolic-Equation Modelling of Urban Microcells: A Component-Wise Error Budget over Leontovich Ground and Knife Screens' (IET Microwaves, Antennas & Propagation, MAP-2026-10-0176). It contains the 3D wide-angle SSFT-PE solver and reference methods (coherent 3D ray model, independent Yee FDTD, analytic references), four processed .npz data files, and a reproduce_tables.py driver that recomputes the reported tables and validation numbers without re-running the full-wave simulations. See README.md for contents and verification.
